The shapes the audit found kept whole or in part (finding F2 of
docs/v2/working-papers/audit/redact.md, and redact-m2), as secrets. They are
recorded as misses, not fixed: their recall in rates.txt is what the rules
change under (LG-26). See README.md for the format.
